name: mirage
text: Understood on both. I'll start from the research already in the repo (profit studies, the PropLine CLV work, the engine's graded lines) and the APIs that carry history and closing lines (PropLine, SportsGameOdds, OddsPapi), then check the findings against published sources on closing-line value, devigging and favorite-longshot bias, and cite them in the write-up. For thin coverage: today one pricing company already caps a bet at 1½ stars and two at 3. I'll add a further demotion when the books pricing it are small-name ones.
